```{r}
donnees <- read.csv("Donnees_qualite_vins.csv", sep = ",")
summary(donnees)
```

```{r}
cor(donnees)
#les quaracteristiques qui influencent le plus la qualité du vin sont l'alcohol, le volatile.acidity et les sulphates
```

```{r}
library(class)
library(dplyr)
library(caTools)
set.seed(2026)

split = sample.split(donnees$quality, 
                     SplitRatio = 0.75)
train = subset(donnees, 
                      split == TRUE)
test = subset(donnees, 
                  split == FALSE)
train_scaled = train
test_scaled = test
for (i in 1:10) {
  train_scaled[i] = scale(train_scaled[i])
  test_scaled[i] = scale(test_scaled[i])
}
```
